title: Durable GitHub provider and compound publication

composition.push: GitSafePublication.preview/apply with exact lease, commit, and tree readback
composition.pullRequest: durable intent before mutation, exact draft PR reconciliation and verification
composition.workflow: exact pushed-commit discovery, bounded durable polling, selected-job verification
composition.artifacts: bounded capture with exact source commit/tree and digest-verified Baby artifact references

cases: immutable intent replay and changed-intent rejection
lost pull-request response reconciliation without duplicate write
workflow completion replay and exact-source artifact capture
partial success after verified push without duplicate push

notes: The existing G3 coverage ledger remains local-Git-only and is not broadened by this checkpoint.
Checkpoint F implements provider and compound workflow source without advertising it in the active runtime.
A failure after verified push is recorded as terminal partial success; the push is not silently rolled back or repeated.
